purpose: Define validation of operations, events, flows, effects, ordering and runtime execution boundaries so execution semantics are explicit and cannot arise from incidental serialization or topology.

topics.name: Behavior and Causality Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation of operations, events, flows, effects, ordering and runtime execution boundaries so execution semantics are explicit and cannot arise from incidental serialization or topology.

semantics.ordering_rule: Execution order must come from explicit causal/flow semantics, never ordinary JSON array position.
semantics.effect_rule: Side effects are explicitly declared and authorized.
semantics.dispatch_rule: Runtime effects cross canonical dispatcher/operation boundaries.
semantics.payload_rule: Payload/model/tool/backend output remains inert until explicit operation consumes it.
semantics.bound_rule: Dynamic operations, loops, queues, retries and recursion satisfy applicable finite bounds.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Terminal success/error/timeout/cancel paths satisfy declared cleanup requirements.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: execution order inferred from incidental array order
payload/model output directly executes arbitrary effect
